## What's new

Threadnote 4.0.4 adds a native Cursor plugin integration so its agent instructions apply across Cursor projects without
writing a project rule into `~/.cursor/rules`.

- **Install the Cursor rule automatically.** When Cursor is present, `threadnote install`, `threadnote update`, and
  `threadnote repair` install or refresh a local Threadnote plugin at `~/.cursor/plugins/local/threadnote`.
- **Use Cursor's documented rule anatomy.** The plugin provides an always-applied `.mdc` rule with a description and
  the complete Threadnote agent instruction block.
- **Preserve user-owned plugins.** Threadnote replaces and removes only plugin directories carrying its ownership
  marker; symlinks and unmarked directories are left untouched with a warning.
- **Diagnose only relevant setups.** `threadnote doctor` checks the plugin only when Cursor is installed, validating its
  manifest, version, rule frontmatter, and injected instruction block.

Existing Cursor users can install the integration immediately, then reload the Cursor window:

```bash
threadnote repair
threadnote doctor
```
